meta.name: add-ollama-provider
meta.description: Route a NanoClaw agent group to a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API. Ollama speaks the Anthropic API natively (v1/messages), so no provider code changes are needed — just env var overrides and a model setting. Use when the user wants to run their agent locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weight models. See docs/ollama.md for background.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把指定的智能体组改用本地 Ollama 模型,不再走 Anthropic API。它会帮你改配置、设模型、重启服务,并验证是否生效。想换回官方 API 时也能帮你还原。
howto.when: 当用户想本地运行智能体、降低 API 费用或试验开放权重模型时触发,它会把智能体组切换到本地 Ollama。

say.text: 把「coder」组切换到本地 Ollama 的 qwen3-coder 模型
say.note: 会自动改配置、设模型并重启服务

say.text: 给「chat」组配置 Ollama,并屏蔽 Anthropic API
say.note: 会添加环境变量和 blockedHosts 参数

say.text: 把「coder」组切回 Anthropic API,移除 Ollama 环境变量
say.note: 会删除配置并重启服务

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude can route a specified agent group to a local Ollama model instead of the Anthropic API. It edits configs, sets the model, rebuilds/restarts the service, verifies, and can revert to the official API.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to run their agent locally, cut API costs, or experiment with open-weight models.

say_en.text: Switch the 'coder' group to the local Ollama qwen3-coder model
say_en.note: Edits config, sets model, and restarts the service

say_en.text: Configure Ollama for the 'chat' group and block the Anthropic API
say_en.note: Adds env vars and blockedHosts settings

say_en.text: Switch the 'coder' group back to the Anthropic API and remove Ollama config
say_en.note: Removes env and model, then restarts
